scope: 고정 G 원P9의 rect가 완료 H7 밖에 처음 드러나는 경계다. 화면 픽셀이나 실제 DOM 승인은 아니다.
beforeAndAt: R(p) is nested and R(7/484) is a subset of the original H7 main rectangle, so P9 intersect R(p) has no ink outside completed H7 for 0<p<=7/484.
after: For each p>7/484, the open witness rectangle with width2delta and height min(delta,(121/5)*(p-7/484)/2) lies inside original P9 body and R(p), outside both original H7 polygons. Its positive area tends to zero at the exit boundary.
